subject.title: [Feature]: Allow telegram groups by creating allowList of users

question: Should OpenClaw add a bundled Telegram `groupPolicy: "members"` mode, and should it verify all current group members against trusted numeric IDs with fail-closed behavior on uncertain membership checks?
rationale: This changes who may trigger agents from Telegram groups and introduces a new config/security boundary that automation should not choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve fail-closed members policy
options.body: Define a Telegram-only policy that verifies all current group members against trusted numeric IDs and blocks on uncertain membership checks.

options.title: Keep explicit group allowlists
options.body: Decline the bundled policy for now and keep users on explicit group chat allowlists or community plugin workarounds.

recommendation.title: Approve fail-closed members policy
recommendation.body: Define a Telegram-only policy that verifies all current group members against trusted numeric IDs and blocks on uncertain membership checks.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the official project lead and already provided the detailed prior review of this exact security/config boundary.
